name: Rainbow Bubble Storm
description: A meadow filled with giant iridescent bubbles catching rainbow light after rain.
prompt: A single joyful image: a sunlit meadow after rain filled with hundreds of giant iridescent soap bubbles floating at different heights, rainbows refracting across their surfaces, wildflowers and wet grass, children reaching up, soft clouds and sunbeams, crisp detail, vibrant and dreamy, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: A storm you’d actually want to run into. 🌈🫧
